posts.title: Midnight Calendar - minimalist calendar app
posts.description: Hey night owls :3 I've been tinkering on an Android app: Midnight Calendar You can install it via Obtainium or wait until it's included in F-Droid. Midnight Calendar is a calendar widget for Android, providing a simple, text-based view on what events are coming up soon.
